lines.english: "Hey."
"Kazusa…"
"I heard from Miyoko-san. She said you were hospitalized again."
"Only a precaution. I'm making sure I improve my health enough to be present for your concert."
"Thanks, I guess… Hey, has that flowerpot been washed?"
"…Why are you here?"
"I'm checking on my sick mother. What else does it look like I'm doing?"
"Seeing you come with a bouquet of flowers is so out of place it's actually scary. Did Nori-kun tell you something? Perhaps he told you that I had only a month to live or something?"
"Are you that weirded out by seeing me not come empty-handed? How little faith could you possibly have in your daughter?"
"Anyway, I'll go get the flowers planted. I'll be right back."
"Tell one of the nurses to do that for you. I won't have you cutting yourself on the flower thorns."
"By the way, I heard."
"Heard what?"
"That you bought back that old ruin."
"…Actually, I never managed to get anyone to buy it, so all I did was get it back from the real estate agency…"
"It still couldn't have been cheap."
"Yes, it wasn't cheap. And considering the state it's in, I'll have to spend a fortune on renovation too, since someone decided to break the windows."
"Ooh, I wonder what horrible person could have done such a thing. A burglar, maybe?"
"Hm?"
"Didn't you come to give me hell for that?"
"It's not like I have the right to complain about how you spend your own money. It's not like you've made a fortune on me either."
"That's not what I was trying to say. Are you doing this on purpose?"
"…Maybe."
"Once the renovations are done, I'm going back there. I'm not going back to Vienna anymore."
"I had actually planned to live there with you."
"That's amazing. If that actually happened, it would be the greatest thing you've achieved in eight years."
"So you did come here to give me a piece of your mind, huh?"
"…Sorry, that came out by instinct. I didn't come here to say that. In fact, I came to say the opposite."
"So… what is it?"
"I'm sorry, Mom… I've…"
"…I see. You're going back to Vienna."
"…I understand your reasoning and your feelings. And I know that I should be there for you, as family, but…"
"…But?"
"I can't be in Japan anymore because… I did something unspeakable here."
"You're going to take him with you, aren't you?"
"…Yeah."
"Congratulations… in a way."
"It's okay, I don't want you to congratulate me so miserably. I'm fully aware of just what I did."
"Yet your entire body is radiating happiness. You're practically floating. The complete opposite of what he was like."
"Have you seen him recently?"
"Yesterday, he escorted me to the hospital. Miyo-chan was gone on a different errand."
"That explains it… So you already know everything. About my decision."
"Not even your mother was capable of stealing a man like that in her glory days."
"It's all my fault. It's all because I'm so weak…"
"Kazusa."
"I'm always relying on you because I'm weak, yet I know you're no longer in any condition to help me, which makes me even more helpless…"
"So in the end, I made the worst possible decision."
"…The worst possible decision for everyone except for you, that is. And of course, he is no exception."
"…Yes."
"Kazusa, you'll make him… and everyone around him unhappy. All because of this childish, romanticized love you have."
"I'll accept anything that comes my way."
"…Then don't look so happy. If the others were to see you like this, they'd lose their minds."
"Do I look that happy?"
"I was kidding. I was just a bit annoyed by my daughter, who loves a boy ten times more than her own mother."
"…I'm sorry."
"…Well, it's fine. You'll make it up for me by giving it your all on the next concert."
"Yeah…"
"Only three days now. How are you feeling?"
"I feel great. I could go on stage right now and play."
"I see, that's good."
"It'll be my last concert in Japan… and I won't leave behind any regrets."
"I suppose it'll be the last time I can hear you play in person too…"
"…Mom."
"…I feel a bit tired. Could you give me some time to rest?"
"Okay. I have to go back to the studio anyway. I'll be back."
"Alright then… I'm looking forward to your concert."
"Hey, Mom…"
"What?"
"Even though we might be separated, even though I'm the daughter who abandoned you and ran away…"
"…Would you still love Touma Kazusa even if she wasn't a pianist anymore?"
"…Are you going to stop playing?"
"I'm not thinking of quitting."
"Then why did you bring that up all of a sudden?"
"Just a theoretical question, and a completely pointless one… See you."
"…Kazusa?"
"…And the tour documents are in this folder. I've set it up so you can find the instructions in these documents."
"Here is a list containing the contact information for those working on the project. I'll leave you their business cards too…"
"…Hey."
"Was I unclear about something?"
"They said you were done with your special cover."
"Yes, and it's all proof-read too. All that's left is to wait for it to be published."
"So that means, once you're done teaching me all this, you're not coming back…"
"…I'll still be an employee here until March. We can take our time and make sure you're fit to take over for me this coming month."
"Don't treat me like an idiot. I've been working here two years longer than you. I can learn all of this stuff by next week."
"…I'm sorry."
Ten days after my sudden resignation.
As a desperate measure by my unhappy superiors, all my work is being temporarily transferred to Matsuoka-san.
"The hard part will be once you're gone. You know my workload will be doubled because of this? And our editing department doesn't have any plans for recruitment yet."
Once this measure was decided on, thinking that no one else would accept such an assignment, Matsuoka-san looked a bit deep in thought and eventually stepped forward.
"After all, no one could have imagined last year that we'd have someone hop off from Kaiou Graph. The recruitment period ended long ago."
Of course, he didn't forget to glare at me the moment he accepted it.
"Hamada-san is doing his best to come to a solution with HR, but for now, we'll have to live with increasing the workload."
"I'm really sorry for causing such a mess…"
"I have no idea what kind of family situation you're dealing with… But to me, I can see this as nothing else but you just pushing your job on someone else and hightailing it."
"…I know."
"I heard you said no to a farewell party."
"Because this isn't a respectable resignation… and I doubt anyone would come."
Ever since it was made known I was resigning, the air around the editing department has taken a nosedive.
"How could you possibly know that? Isn't it because you're always building walls between yourself and others, that no one can come up to you and talk?"
"…I'm sorry."
Hamada-san has become more irritable with his subordinates. Suzuki-san has stopped chatting, and Kizaki-san has been exclusively focused on work.
"God, you irritate the hell out of me. You were always like this, but ever since you decided to quit, you've worsened tenfold!"
"…Right."
And practically the only person who will talk to me… Or rather, the only person who has no choice but to talk to me for work related reasons, is Matsuoka-san, and he's been in a sour mood every time.
He continuously points out all the problems with me that I'm only too well aware of, and unable to respond to.

Couple the disappearance of chatter from the editing department with the passing of the deadline for the Air Pocket, and you would find the office so quiet that you could wonder whether this is a publishing office at all.
"Hey."
"What is it?"
"Don't you feel the slightest desire to make this up to me? You've robbed me of all my days off from next month on."
"If… there is anything I can do."
This is another thing my decision brought along. Another fragment of the world I destroyed.
If I could even slightly make up for this, I'll…
"Good… once your quota is done for today, we're going for a drink."
"You're paying for my drink, of course. After pushing all your work on me, that's only natural."
"Matsuoka-san…?"
I was prepared to face any form of abuse…
"In exchange, I'll pay for your drink. I am the guest of honor at your farewell party, after all."
"Isn't that… just called splitting the bill?"
"Shut up and don't worry about the details. Are you coming or not? And don't talk back to me, rookie."
Hamada-san has become more irritable with his subordinates. Suzuki-san has stopped chatting, and Kizaki-san has been exclusively focused on work.
And Matsuoka-san…
"…Thank you very much!"
"You'll regret thanking me, you know. I'll be throwing abuse at you every second of the way."
"Okay… I'll be prepared."
He glares at me with a stern expression, and hits me lightly on the shoulder.
"I see…"
"So I'm sorry, but I'll be back late today. I'll come home once I'm done drinking, so about dinner…"
"Ah, I got it. I'll eat something outside."
"Be careful about what you eat, okay? Make sure to get plenty of vegetables, and avoid alcohol and sweet foods. Your concert is tomorrow."
"You sound more like my mother than my mother. That's why people get so jealous of you."
"…Who is jealous of me?"
"Anyway, I got it. Go with your friends; it's your farewell party, isn't it? …Let yourself loose every now and then."
"Okay… I'll do that. I'm sorry for not being with you on the day before your concert."
"I'm fine. More importantly, you should go and have fun."
"Ah, by the way… when can I enter the venue tomorrow?"
"I'll begin by afternoon. We may end up passing each other."
"Can I wake you up before going to work tomorrow? I just want to spend some time talking to you."
"Okay, got it. I'll go to sleep early then."
"Good night, then."
"Yeah…"
"He's… going to be late."
"That makes things easier…"
"Ah…"
"You actually came."
"Thank you… Setsuna."
"I'm… sorry."
"…For what?"
"Um, uhm… for asking you to come at this hour."
"Ah… if that's your concern, I'm always free."
"But you still live at home with your parents…"
"Don't worry. I've been away from home ever since last week. I'm living in a business hotel."
"Huh, why?"
"…They're annoying, my family. I don't want to see them."
"…Huh?"
"Now of all times, I'm starting to understand what you meant all those years ago, Kazusa. I really wish they'd leave me alone."
"S-Setsuna…?"
"But you're way more important right now! Your additional concert is tomorrow, right?"
"Eh? R-Right…"
"Your concert last month was a massive success. Don't you feel pressure from having to live up to it?"
"…I think I'll be fine this time. My practice is completely done, so all that is left is a good night's sleep and I'll be ready."
"I see… How wonderful. Yeah, I'm really glad! Do your absolute best! Aaah, I won't be able to come see you. I'm so sorry!"
"U-Um… Setsuna…"
"Hey, about those glasses."
"I couldn't tell who you were at first, and your hairstyle is completely different. But as expected, you look good in everything."
"O-Oh, this is just for show. People kept recognizing me, so…"
"Wow, you really hit it big, huh! You're famous throughout Japan now."
"But I haven't really changed at all…"
"That's not true! After all, you won a prize in the Giovanni International Competition."
"Yeah, but I didn't even make the top three, let alone win it. Besides, I wonder if anyone even knows the names of the winners."
"But you were still in the highest position as someone from Japan. That will spark a fuss over here, obviously."
"That's not true. It's because I'm Youko's daughter. It's because my last name is Touma, that's all."
"No, that's not all. It's your own talent that brought you this far, Kazusa. Nothing else."
"That's not true…"
"It is true! You have so much."
"S-Setsuna…"
"You have your piano, your trophies, your looks. Not to mention, you even have… you even have…"
"Stop it, you're embarrassing me."
"…Someone you love."
"You have everything, Kazusa."
"Before I knew it, everything became yours…"
"Setsuna…"
"Oh, there he is! What's up? Having fun?"
As the two of us were drinking at the bar we always used to visit, a voice calls out to us in a familiar tone.
"I was just about to tell this guy how selfish and inconsiderate he is. How incapable he is of doing his job and how he is practically the worst person who ever lived."

"You're the last person who can judge someone for being inconsiderate, Macchan. Ah, well, I suppose it's only fair since you got the shortest end of the stick in all this. I'll have a beer too, by the way."
"Suzuki-san…?"
But for her to be the one who happened to join in, was far too unlikely…
"This whole thing was actually Suzuki-san's idea. My task was to drag you out here."
"Why…?"
"Because if we asked you about an official farewell party, you'd go stubborn on us and say no."
"That's not what I wanted to ask…"
Ever since I said I was quitting, the air around the editing department has been heavy.
Hamada-san has become more irritable with his subordinates. And Suzuki-san, who's now in front of me, has stopped chatting.
"Obviously, this doesn't mean everything is settled. Because it's clearly not."
"You went ahead and quit without even saying why. It'd be odd if we didn't get mad at you for that. Had you been our superior and something like this happened, you'd chew us out the whole day."
"You're right, yet…"
Even so, these two seniors of mine who I rarely have conversations with are right next to me now, and they're making merry at my farewell party as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
"When we were out drinking yesterday, I cursed your name with every bad word in the book. That's why I can keep my mouth shut and see you off today."
He's accepting my selfishness, along with the senior who was always so strict with me.
"We don't want to end this with a bad taste in our mouths. If we count your time here as a part-timer, we've been working together as friends for over three years."
"That's precisely the reason I'm so pissed you're just leaving without saying a word…"
"But I'm sure you spent a lot of time thinking it over, with a fervor to last you a lifetime. You're that kind of guy, after all."
"That's not…"
"Well then, cheers!"
"This one is for Kitahara-kun, and his fortune in his future endeavors."
"…I'm sorry."
"What for?"
"What do you mean, 'what for'…? Well, you know…"
"Why do you look so hesitant? You're not acting like the beautiful genius pianist who's the hot topic of Japan right now."
"Then, I'll say it clearly… I'm sorry for taking what's yours, Setsuna."
"I'm sorry for being so bad at giving up. I'm sorry for betraying you in the worst possible way… I'm sorry for loving Haruki after all this time…"
"He, hehe…"
"Setsuna?"
"There really is no reason for you to apologize about anything. Hehe, ahaha…"
"B-But I…"
"I already knew. I knew that your feelings hadn't changed, Kazusa."
"I always knew, for these past five years. I knew that if you and Haruki-kun were to meet each other again, this would happen."
"But you know what? I've found a way for all three of us to be happy. So you don't have to worry."
"And what… is that?"
"We can just… be together, all three of us, forever."
"So you don't need to apologize at all. After all, we're all going to become happy."
"…That's impossible, Setsuna. That's just a dream of yours."
"Why…? We managed it back then, so why not…?"
"What are you talking about…? We didn't manage at all back then!"
"Huh…?"
"I couldn't bear seeing you two together. That's why I ran away in the first place!"
"It's my jealousy that ruined everything…"
"Kazusa…"
"No matter how fun it was being with you two, before I knew it, I found myself jealous of you. I detested you."
"No matter how much I love you, seeing you with Haruki… seeing the two of you in love with each other just isn't something I can abide by…"
"That's why I can't be with you from now on either. I have no choice but to take Haruki away from you, even if that means…"
"Are you sure you're not just overthinking it?"
"Eh?"
"…The Haruki-kun you desire, is he really the actual Haruki-kun?"
"…What's that supposed to mean?"
"Isn't the Haruki-kun you know something you constructed in your head during the five years you spent away from him? Like an idol?"
"…! Setsuna!"
"All this time, I've known the real Haruki-kun."
"For three years, I was always looking at him from a distance. For two years, I was by his side."
"Setsuna… didn't you just say so yourself? That you knew my feelings wouldn't change?"
"Even if your feelings haven't changed, Haruki-kun has changed. Why can't you understand that?"
"Are you saying that my feelings are a lie…? Are you saying I'm just deluded…?"
"Then tell me, Kazusa, how many of Haruki-kun's weak points do you know?"
"I know all about his bad aspects, his weaknesses… And even more so, I know about all his good aspects, his wonderful aspects. I can't even count them."
"Unlike the man you carefully constructed in your dreams for five years… my Haruki-kun is real."
"Are you telling me… I don't know the real Haruki?"
"Am I wrong…?"
"Are you joking? Do you think that the ideal man I made up in my head could make me feel so much suffering, to make me cry?"
"Kazusa…"
"Would the ideal man hesitate so much before accepting me? Would he go through so much pain for choosing me!?"
"Even if these past five years have been nothing but a dream, these past few days I have been struggling against reality…"
"And I wasn't crushed between the gap of ideal and reality."
"I love Haruki as he is now…"
"I love Haruki-kun as he is now, too."
"I love how he still hasn't changed at all when it comes to being by the book in every little thing!"
"The way he only fights harder when he's suffering. How little by little, he becomes kinder and stronger… And every time he changes, I fall in love with him all over again."
"I already knew, but… we can never go back to how things were, can we?"
"So all I can do is to atone…"
"He, hehe."
"Huh?"
"You have no reason to apologize to me. Hehe, ahaha…"
"S-Setsuna?"
"Because after all, I found a solution that will make all three of us happy. So it's okay, it's all going to be okay!"
"H-Hey…!"
"We can just… be together, all three of us, forever."
"I won't deny your feelings… I approve of you two being together."
"Setsuna… what's the matter with you?"
"After all, I'm the one in the wrong. I betrayed you five years ago, and I caused Haruki-kun pain…"
"I wasn't asking about that! We already finished talking about that!"
"Eh? We did?"
"S-Setsuna…"
"Oh? …Ah, it happened again."
"Again…?"
"Was I saying strange things? Was I incomprehensible?"
"Ah, no… it's just that…"
"Everyone's been telling me that the past few days."
"Everyone…?"
"They say that I forget what I just said and repeat myself, or that I contradict my own words."
"I wonder what's going on. Maybe I've lost it…"
"N-No… that can't…"
"Ahaha… you don't have to be so considerate. The truth is, I'm also somewhat aware of how I've been acting."
"You can't have…"
"Before I know it, I sometimes find myself completely forgetting what people just said to me, or what I just said to them."
"Ah, ah…"
"Just earlier, when I hung up a call I had with someone, I completely forgot what the call was about. I can't go to work like this."

"That's why they took away some responsibilities from me at work yesterday. They told me to take the day off and go visit a doctor, and that they wouldn't allow me to do anything important for a while."
"So… did you go? To the hospital, I mean."
"Hey, what do you think, Kazusa? Have I really lost it completely?"
"How could I possibly know that? Please, let's go to the hospital, okay?"
"I suppose I don't mind being so broken, though…"
"Setsuna!"
"After all, if I break down completely… If I forget everything, I'll be unable to go on living without him."
"If I do that, do you think Haruki-kun will reconsider? Do you think he'll hesitate a little bit for my sake…?"
"Don't say that… Don't ever say that!"
"What do you think, Kazusa? Can I ever win against you?"
"I don't know, I don't know, I don't know…! All I know is that he'll suffer again if you do that."
"As if you had any right to say that… After chasing him into a corner in the first place?"
"He told me that there is no point in talking about what could have been. That those possibilities never came true, so there is no point in considering them."
"Then, in that case… If I really…"
"Not just him… I'll suffer too. I'll be frantically wondering about what I'm supposed to do!"
"I see… I see…"
"But despite that…"
"Hmm?"
"Despite that, I'll never give up on Haruki again."
"Kazusa…"
"Kept you waiting! Sorry, Karasawa-sensei always keeps me tied up for as long as he can."
"Ah…"
A few minutes after our second toast…
"You're late! I almost thought you weren't coming!"
"You'll want a beer to start off, right? Excuse me, we'll have two more of this!"
And before we know it, we share our third toast.
"I'm really sorry, Kitahara. To think I'd be late for your farewell party."
"Even you, Kizaki-san…"
Recently, he has been focused on nothing but his work, and even when we passed each other by, he never said a word.
"Why do you look so gloomy?
Ah, perhaps these two gave you hell already?"
"N-No… no…"
He gives me a light tap on the back like he used to, and looks at me with a vague smile just like he used to.
At my farewell party.
"Macchan's horrible, isn't he? By the time I arrived, he had already made Kitahara-kun cry. I got in between them and have been doing my best to comfort him."
"That's the complete opposite of what happened! The atmosphere got really heavy the moment you arrived. It felt like you held a grudge against him to last two lifetimes."
"Aa-ah, you two are the worst. How about some compassion?"
"That's not… what happened. I'm the one in the wrong."
"…Come on, you can't react so seriously or you'll kill the joke."
"…I forgot. This is Kitahara-kun we're talking about. He can't understand self-deprecating humor to save his life."
"Alright you guys, don't pick on him. In return, I'll cover the entire bill for tonight… is what Hamada-san told me to tell you."
"…Huh?"
And to top it off…
"Ah! What a generous superior!"
"Alright, now that everyone's here, let's give a toast to Hamada-san!"
The person who should have been the most dismayed, after having an employee under his care quit without giving a single reason…
"K-Kizaki-san…?"
"He really wanted to come tonight too, but considering his circumstances, I hope you'll forgive his absence…"
He kept everything closed off in his chest, and now he does this without saying anything.
"H-Hey… Kitahara?"
"Come on, now. Now you're the one picking on Kitahara right after you lectured us, Kizaki-san."
"You haven't even been here a minute and you already made him cry. I swear, the men in our department are such terrible bullies."
"I'm… sorr…! Aa-ha… ahah…!"
"Hey."
"Hmm?"
"Why don't you just go home? We're never going to agree on anything."
"But…"
"No matter what you tell me, I'm probably just going to forget it in a few minutes."
"So you should go home now. Nothing will be solved here, anyway."
"Setsuna…"
"Besides, tomorrow you'll…"
"Listen to me anyway! You can look the other way, ignore me; you can even forget about it later."
"I love you, Setsuna. I love you, and I respect you."
"You were the perfect person from the moment we met. You were strong and straightforward, just like… no, even more than Haruki."
"I was afraid of just how perfect you were, Setsuna. And I was dazzled by your radiance."
"After all, I'm the kind of person who does everything wrong. I'm the complete opposite of you, Setsuna."
"Yet… even though we differed in almost every aspect, your awful taste in men was frighteningly similar to mine…"
"That's why I betrayed you. You tried to understand me, to love me, yet I betrayed you in the worst possible way, twice."
"I can't help myself."
"I know it's not the right thing to do. I know no one will accept it. But I can't help myself from betraying you."
"It's because I'm weak. It's because I'm an awful person that I can't help but to take Haruki away from you."
"That's why the three of us can't be together anymore. It's not your fault, it's not Haruki's fault either… It's my fault."
"I'm sorry."
"I'm sorry, I wasn't listening."
"That's okay. I'm speaking on my own accord."
"That's why, Setsuna…"
"If the strong Setsuna I once knew and adored has lost her strength because of me…"
"I'll make up for it… with my life as a pianist."
"…That would mean nothing."
"Yeah, you're right. It's just for my own self-satisfaction."
"I can't do any house work, in fact, I'm probably incapable of doing anything that helps others."
"…Piano?"
"I know that compared to what I did to you, Setsuna, this isn't nearly enough to make up for it…"
"But my piano is all I have going for me. Without it, I'm completely useless…"
"So… it's the only thing I can give up. I'm sorry, Setsuna."
"Haaah."
It truly had been a while.
Getting wasted like that, talking that much, laughing, and letting loose my feelings.
And the first time in a while I showed such a pathetic side of myself, and the first time I felt relief from pain.
Even though I was supposed to throw everything in Japan away, I made a few memories I can take with me when I leave.
They might have just sugarcoated their words. They might have simply said what they should as proper adults.
Yet I was grateful for their regard for me, from the bottom of my heart.
My entire body feels like it's burning. My face, my throat, and even my eyes.
I'm so drunk, yet…
I've been unable to sleep for the past week, and should be sleep deprived, and yet…
I don't feel like I can fall asleep for a different reason tonight. Perhaps it's better to say that I don't want to sleep.
I feel dizzy from just taking a step out of the elevator.
Normally, I'm the one who lectures my friends and coworkers for drinking this much, while supporting them on my shoulders.
"Here we go…"
I heave a drunk sigh and lean on the wall, and walk alongside it.
All while trying and just barely managing to make as little noise as possible.
After all, Kazusa is asleep.
She has a concert tomorrow. I can't wake her up today of all days.
It'd be fine if she was sleeping in her own apartment, but if she's in my bed, then…
"Mm…"
Kazusa is asleep.
She has a concert tomorrow. I can't wake her up today of all days.
If she's sleeping in her own apartment that'd be fine, but if she's in my…
"Kazusa! Hey, what the hell are you doing?"
This was no time to think of being delicate in my phrasing.
Kazusa was indeed asleep… outside.
"You have a concert tomorrow and you're trying to freeze yourself to death? Come on… Could you please stop being so unreasonable, for once?"
"…Welcome back, Haruki."
Kazusa completely ignores my clumsy outburst and smiles at me gently.
…An expression that radiates loneliness, and pain.
"…Did you lose the key?"
"Ah, I have the keys for both apartments… I think."
"Then why aren't you inside? Literally all you had to do is to turn the key and open the door! How lazy can you be?"
"About that, I, uh… really wanted… to see your face, Haruki."
"Ah, uhm… I told you I was going to show up tomorrow."
"I wanted to see you… right away… or, as fast as I could."
"Kazusa…"
I certainly could sense that her feelings came from a desire to be spoiled by me.
But her voice isn't just conveying her desire to be spoiled; something completely different is spreading across her expression…
"…Show me your hands."
"…Huh?"
"I'll pull you up, come on."
"N-No… I'm fine. I'll stand up on my own."
Without even attempting to grab my outstretched hand, she sits completely still.
She said she wanted to see me, yet here I am, and the uncertainty and bitterness in her eyes have still not gone away.
"Seriously, what happened?"
"W-Well…"
Almost as if trying to get away from my hands, she puts her own hands behind her back and hides them between herself and the wall.
Her behavior was unreasonable as always, yet my intoxication did away with any patience left in me.
"You're going to catch a cold! Get a hold of yourself and stop sulking for no reason!"
"S-Stop it…!"
I kneel in front of her, wrap my hands around her back almost as if embracing her, and feel for her hands.
She resisted, of course, but compared to the strength of a man… or the strength of anyone at all, considering the state she's in…
"Huh!? …What is this?"
Eventually, I grab onto her hands and let out an anguished expression…
"Your hands are almost like ice! Can you even play the piano tomorrow like this? Seriously, what were you thinking…?"
"Why… do I have to be so healthy."
"Huh…?"
And then, she mutters something incomprehensible.
Kazusa's hands were incredibly cold… but like always, they were thin, white and smooth.
"Ah…"
"D-Dear customer?"
"I'm sorry. I dropped this glass. I'll clean it up right away!"
"Ah… N-No! I'll take care of it. Don't touch the glass."
"I'm really sorry… Let's go, Kazusa."
"Setsuna…"
"Why…?"
"Why… did you stop me?"
"I took away all your happiness! I ruined your life!"
"Moreover, this is the second time I've done that. All I've ever done is to get between you and Haruki."
"…I'm your worst enemy."
"Don't you… feel at least a little bit of hatred toward me? Don't you want to make me feel the same pain you feel?"
"I don't know…!"
"I barely understood at all. Nothing you said even registered in my head. None of it mattered to me at all…"
"Then, why?"
"I just said I don't know! I was holding on to your hand before I even realized it. I was desperately trying to stop your idiotic act."
"Ah…"
"…Even though it wasn't supposed to have anything to do with me."
"Setsuna…!"
"Why… Why am I…"
"Setsuna, are you…"
"I'm not…!"
"You really have… You really have…"
"Don't say it!"
"I don't understand… I don't understand anything!"
"About myself, Haruki-kun or even you…!"
"I don't understand anything anymore…"
"Haruki, Haruki, Haruki… Uu-ugh… I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I've…"
"Don't cling to me so much right now. I reek of booze."
"I broke Setsuna… I tried to protect you, but I only made things worse."
"Kazusa…"
No matter how many times I tell her to get off me, or try to push her away, she ignores me completely and rubs her face against my chest.
Almost as if trying to keep the smell of me from escaping, including the smell of alcohol.
"I'm such an idiot…"
"You realize that now?"
"Shut up…!"
Kazusa went to see Setsuna in secret.
It seems because she saw how I was suffering from the ordeal with Setsuna, she tried to go out to protect me herself.
That sounds exactly like her… a thoughtless, rash and pointless action.
"I didn't expect her to forgive me, but I still wanted to apologize. I wanted to make up for it… I wanted to talk to her."
"I see…"
She's so silly.
Obviously, they'd both just end up getting hurt.
Yet the idea of saving me completely took control of her. She did something that had no meaning at all for Setsuna, but something that meant all the world to herself.
"But Setsuna… because of me, she…!"
"Don't cry anymore…"
In the end, she only made things worse for Setsuna. It was plain as day from the start that Setsuna would completely break down.
"You're such an idiot."
"Y-Yeah…"
"No matter how hard you think, you'll never find a good solution. In fact, you'll only make things worse."
"You're completely useless when it comes to things like this."
"Hey… just because it's true… doesn't mean you have to be so extreme about it."
"You're the one who's being extreme. Always thinking of these idiotic things."
"Hm…"
The more I lecture her, the more absurd her actions seem.
"You even thought about abandoning the piano for my sake. Really… you're just so silly that I can't let you out of my sight."
And right before the day of the concert, of all days.
"That's because it's important to me… So it shows just how important you are to me."
And even though her hands were spared, I still have doubts if she can play tomorrow from the pure psychological stress.
"…Drop the idea that in order to gain something valuable, you have to throw away something of equal value."
"Haruki…"
I have some words about her overestimating herself… but right now, I won't touch on any subject heavy in emotion.
If I do, I'll be the one to break down.
"Think of it like this. If you need your piano to be happy, keep it. If you don't need it… then you can throw it away."
Because even now, the warmth of Kazusa's skin, her softness, her sweet smell… light up my senses all in harmony.
"I don't know… I still don't know…"
That warm breath touches my chest, and I find it even harder to restrain myself.
"It was always there since the day I was born. I spent more than half of the time in my life working with it… much more than the time I spent with you."
It is probably not Kazusa's intention to make me feel that way. I'm making a big deal out of it by myself, but it's still cruel.
"And it's not just you. The whole thing with my mom… with Touma Youko, and…"
"Then you don't have to come to a conclusion right away. Once we're back in Vienna… you can take your time and decide."
Doing my best to prevent my inner conflict from becoming apparent to her, I slacken the muscles in my arms and pull Kazusa toward my chest.
I feel her warmth. And allow myself to be restrained.
"That's precisely why… you should forget about everything tomorrow and just play to your heart's content."
"Haruki…"
"Show us what you're made of… and give your Japanese audience your final goodbye."
"Okay…"
In my arms, I feel Kazusa growing warmer.
"I'll play. I'll show you I can. As long as you're by my side, I won't be afraid of anything…"
"Yeah, I'm counting on you…"
"So be there to watch over me during the concert… and all the other times too."
"…What time is it?"
"…3 o'clock, let's go to sleep."
"Okay…"
"Good night, then."
"Good night."
"…Hey."
"Sleep already…"
"When I lie down like this being embraced by you, I can feel my wounds heal. I can get back up on my feet, even if I feel miserable."
"And I'll… keep doing this for you from now on. I won't let you feel lonely anymore…"
"How do you think… Setsuna will heal her wounds from now on?"
"She got hurt so badly because of me. And yet she hasn't changed at all deep down inside."
"Is… that so?"
"She teases me without even realizing it, yet when push comes to shove, she just can't help but destroy herself."
"Not even thinking about how it's breaking her apart…!"
"She's strong, and always sees through people. She is always a step ahead of everybody, and prevents them from getting away…"
"That's why I really don't know how to handle her. I somewhat dislike her, I am jealous of her, and I admire her…"
"But she was hopelessly kind to me, even up until the very end. She refused to admit I was wrong, she let go of my hand, and she stopped me in my tracks…"
"That's why in the end, I couldn't hate her. I loved her…"
"It's okay, you've said enough…"
"That's right. I loved Setsuna!"
"I know…"
"Haruki… if you hadn't come into the picture, perhaps the two of us might have become the best of friends."
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry…"
"…No, if you hadn't been around, I wouldn't even have met her in the first place."
"Kazusa…"
"You were the one who brought Setsuna and I together. And you're also the reason we ended up severing our ties."
"…I'll resent you for that, you know."
"Yeah, resent me for the rest of your life."
"You're fine with it, right? I'll remind you of it for the rest of my life. I'll be by your side, and tell you about it at every opportunity, forever."
"In exchange, I'll defend myself. Like that, we can bicker over it for as long as it takes."
"Haruki…"
"Good night."
"Yeah… Good night."
That's right, let's bicker. As many times as it takes.
Let's overwhelm ourselves in a love so powerful that we can get hurt, quarrel, and get sick of each other, and still go on despite that.
"Even if my love can't reach you… will it one day reflect back to me…?"
"Ah, haha…"
"Haha… ahahahaha…!"
"…Unh… uu…"
"Uuh, uaah…!"
"You coward, you coward…"
"You're such a coward, Ogiso Setsuna!"
"Uu-uh… Uaaah… Aaaah…!"
"Uuh… Uuaah… Uaaaaaaaaaah…!"
"…Huh?"
